g.title: j2875350431
g.text: I find it so terribly fascinating that you schemed with me to... arrange my own path. The devil deals in his own flesh, as it were.

g.title: j3869625108->j2875350431

g.title: j3040500673
g.text: How goes progress on your end, my Usurper? I busily pull strings and levers in your favor, though my influence may be unseen and unfelt thus far.

g.text: RoatheMarieDatingDeal

g.title: j1123061095
g.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. Where I might have proved a barrier of resistance before, regarding your... romantic goals? Now, I shall be as docile as a snow terrisk. Hmm. Unless that is not what you desire. You can be the decider of that.

g.title: j4096163837
g.text: I cannot help but think that you are lingering in these conversations of ours for a reason, Usurper. And that it might be something I can help you with.

g.text: false

g.title: j4118653242
g.text: It is an odd challenge from my perspective, to only be operating with part of my memories intact and knowing you hold the other half of the deck in your hand.

g.title: j4195590714
g.text: But all this... milling about that you are doing? It is merely wasting time. So come now. Say the word. And your problem will be solved.

g.title: j2639682456
g.text: Tell me what you're after, and let us come to an agreement. All this... milling about is merely wasting time.

g.title: j2075111951
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2694130358->j2075111951
g.text: false

g.title: j4015830994
g.text: So I shall just carry on, then, for lack of anything better to do. "How goes it with our little floating sycophant, by the by? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you." Bah. What a farce.

g.title: j77183960
g.text: No. I'm sorry. I don't make arrangements with Orokin. Not then, not now, not ever.

g.title: j3240686939
g.text: I really hope you don't make me regret this, Roathe. Fine. Agreed. I need your help.

g.title: j2953660143
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j2171603518
g.text: How goes your progress so far with our little floating sycophant? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.

g.title: j2075111951->j2171603518
g.text: RoatheDeal

g.title: j102000582
g.text: Tell me, have you changed your mind on my offer? This will be your last chance, Usurper. I am a patient devil, but I do not like to be left about to hold doors open like a fool.

g.title: j2075111951->j102000582
g.text: RoatheNoDeal

g.title: j2075111951->j102000582
g.text: false

g.title: j926850260
g.text: I'm getting along all right with Marie, so far.

g.title: j511563311
g.text: No, but he'll come around.

g.title: j1014455088
g.text: You don't seem to like them very much. Why?

g.title: j838671903
g.text: As you wish. Fair warning, this was your last opportunity. You are on your own, now.

g.title: j1876832257
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j305546780
g.text: Lyon has... there's so much he's dealing with. And I don't know how to get through it all.

g.title: j2953660143->j305546780
g.text: true

g.title: j2953660143->j305546780
g.text: false

g.title: j1378222389
g.text: Marie won't see Entrati for what he is. And I cannot get her to see the truth of it, no matter what I do.

g.title: j2953660143->j1378222389
g.text: true

g.title: j2953660143->j1378222389
g.text: false

g.title: j963473320
g.text: Well, you see, you have this whole... thing about why you took the serum, and I... said the wrong things at the wrong times.

g.title: j2953660143->j963473320
g.text: true

g.title: j2953660143->j963473320
g.text: false

g.title: j304545581
g.text: It might be a little embarrassing, but... I have feelings for one of you three.

g.title: j2953660143->j304545581
g.text: true

g.title: j2953660143->j304545581
g.text: false

g.title: j475786744
g.text: I am trying to get you and the others to help me reunite Loid with the family upstairs and... I... couldn't...

g.title: j2953660143->j475786744
g.text: false

g.title: j568971278
g.text: No, Lyon... doesn't seem to talk much.

g.title: j2087445063
g.text: I'm getting on well with Marie. Why do you call her a sycophant?

g.title: j2544677686
g.text: You don't seem to like them very much. Why?

g.title: j3822298111
g.text: No. I'm sorry. I don't make agreements with Orokin. Not then, not now, not ever.

g.title: j152445645
g.text: I really hope you don't make me regret this, Roathe. Fine. Agreed.

g.title: j1031925304
g.text: "So far." Intriguing. And we really are all just retracing our steps, like courtiers echoing the moves of a dance? Again and again, doomed to repeat ourselves?

g.title: j3321315650
g.text: I suppose you would know, wouldn't you? Interesting that it is so predictable. Nice to know even someone as shattered as he is, can still be counted upon now and then.

g.title: j662852507
g.text: Don't you already know? Mm. Perhaps you did not make it that far. Or you did not think to ask the first or twenty-thousandth time through this little romp.

g.title: j113242122
g.text: Oh. And one more thing, before I forget?

g.title: j1052217618
g.text: How you have truly sold your soul to the devil and twice over... making an arrangement to ensure I take you to my bed? Or are you after my heart, Usurper? Mm. We shall see. But in time.

g.title: j1876832257->j1052217618
g.text: RoatheDatingDealNo

g.title: j4266297471
g.text: When the time comes, I shall ensure your path is clear to woo our little floating sycophant, Usurper. Consider it dealt with.

g.title: j1876832257->j4266297471
g.text: RoatheMarieDatingDealNo

g.title: j3537689908
g.text: When the time comes, I shall ensure your path is clear to woo the poor shattered priest, Usurper. Consider it dealt with.

g.title: j1876832257->j3537689908
g.text: RoatheLyonDatingDealNo

g.title: j2239222002
g.text: When the time comes, I shall remember this. Should we have a further disagreement about my memories, we shall not repeat your previous mistakes.

g.title: j1876832257->j2239222002
g.text: RoatheSerumDealNo

g.title: j49853574
g.text: When the time comes, I will ensure that little butler walks up those stairs. Consider it dealt with.

g.title: j1876832257->j49853574
g.text: RoatheFamilyDealNo

g.title: j1622804986
g.text: Consider your issue with Marie and her sycophantic adoration of Entrati dealt with. When the time comes, I shall handle it.

g.title: j1876832257->j1622804986
g.text: RoatheMarieEntratiDealNo

g.title: j4170632380
g.text: Consider your issue with Lyon and his horrors dealt with, Usurper. When the time comes, I shall handle it.

g.title: j1876832257->j4170632380
g.text: RoatheLyonConfessionDealNo

g.title: j1231027373
g.text: I... appear to have forgotten what it was you were after. Blame your meddling with my memories. What was it again?

g.title: j1876832257->j1231027373
g.text: false

g.title: j2629408695
g.text: I would counsel simple patience instead, but... far be it from me to advise you to use a chisel when there is a laser pick sitting next to you.

g.title: j4030764894
g.text: Hm. I see. A noble endeavor, if I am being honest. One that I have attempted myself many, many times over. And failed equally so.

g.title: j2696378933
g.text: Hm.

g.title: j3553461153
g.text: Lyon.

g.title: j456479209
g.text: ... You.

g.title: j1130953151
g.text: Marie.

g.title: j3918720428
g.text: Hm. I see. I offered you an arrangement, and you could not hold up your end of the bargain somehow, so you saw your prize fade from view.

g.title: j4181519821
g.text: When he does speak, it generally falls into two categories - horrifically inane or horrifically insane.

g.title: j3110192734
g.text: Hm? Have you escaped it thus far? I am so terribly envious of you. It won't be long before you are caught up in the blast radius however, so it's best you have fair warning.

g.title: j81386535
g.text: My poor Drifter. Have you forgotten how strictly we Orokin rejected any sense of holy deities? The only thing we worshiped was ourselves.

g.title: j1942911382
g.text: As you wish. I warn you, this decision of yours cannot be undone without consequences.

g.title: j221037881
g.text: You behave and help me get Loid to go upstairs and reconcile with the family? And I'll help you sort out your memories.

g.title: j2932790564
g.text: It doesn't mean you lack agency. It just means some things take a few more tries.

g.title: j1546742368
g.text: I hope it doesn't upset you.

g.title: j3532872981
g.text: Are we truly all doomed to repeat ourselves, like courtiers echoing the moves of a dance?

g.title: j1928402330
g.text: Not so very long ago, I trusted you with a horrible truth. Now I cannot remember why.

g.title: j926694468
g.text: Boolean RoatheFamilyDealNo is now false.

g.title: j121818852
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonDatingDealNo is now false.

g.title: j2085775682
g.text: Boolean RoatheSerumDealNo is now false.

g.title: j3462266243
g.text: Boolean RoatheMarieEntratiDealNo is now false.

g.title: j4269396371
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonConfessionDealNo is now false.

g.title: j2995668280
g.text: I think I am also starting to understand why you have wiped our minds clean. Seeing all your failed attempts and endeavors... why not strike the board and try again?

g.title: j464502831
g.text: Seeing in frustration that you could no longer convince her of the simple truth of things, you resorted to that which was - using this... gift of yours.

g.title: j3852084340
g.text: I do not appreciate you fouling my mind to fix your mistakes, Drifter. However, that you are attempting to do it for my sake is... I suppose, somehow, acceptable.

g.title: j1045097103
g.text: Boolean DrifterLyon is now true.

g.title: j1353142197
g.text: Boolean DrifterRoathe is now true.

g.title: j3924947113
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j1171129388
g.text: So, knowing you could no longer achieve that which was previously in your grasp, you resorted to that which was - using this... gift of yours.

g.title: j1246947180
g.text: It is always a flip of the coin which one you're liable to get, and I can never decide which one I prefer more.

g.title: j727160247
g.text: That woman is interminable in her unwavering and obsessive dedication for Albrecht. I would say the butler should be worried, but I honestly firmly believe it is an innocent devotion. And this is coming from me.

g.title: j507127564
g.text: Those two zealots cannot go two minutes without "Sol" this or "Lua" that or without trying to bless the piss pot.

g.title: j3004451806
g.text: Boolean RoatheFamilyFail is now true.

g.title: j2170049129
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3403619673
g.text: I am amused by your optimism. Heroes. That's all you people are, I swear. Bags of meat and bone inflated and operated purely by optimism and hope. It's enough to make your teeth rot.

g.title: j2315471601
g.text: No, you misunderstand me. In a way, I find it comforting. It means that even when you strip us down to our bare components, we are still the same. We cannot change.

g.title: j3936514315
g.text: You are both the one soul I may have ever hoped to trust... and the reason I now cannot recall why I had dared.

g.title: j2376422441
g.text: Boolean RoatheFamilyDeal is now true.

g.title: j2220754840
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonDatingDeal is now true.

g.title: j2674160262
g.text: Boolean RoatheSerumDeal is now true.

g.title: j1911424713
g.text: Boolean RoatheMarieEntratiDeal is now true.

g.title: j2107652340
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonConfessionDeal is now true.

g.title: j1201743634
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j2322312000
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j1563784489
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j773999891
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2170421206
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j190051100
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j769180499
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j1791053690
g.text: Hysterically enough? I still prefer him over the sister. At least he can be reasoned with.

g.title: j2545800578
g.text: She simply is just that mind-numbingly sanctimonious.

g.title: j2719350922
g.text: Which I will have you know, they still used in that damn cathedral! Actual -

g.title: j1098002312
g.text: But to quote the little floating sycophant? C'est la vie. How goes it with her, by the by? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.

g.title: j130497891
g.text: I am so pleased you have come around and we can finally move forward! I thought we were going to be trapped going about in circles like that for centuries.

g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j2631304166
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j524649683
g.text: Understand what that makes you to me.

g.title: j2271527703
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2018207743
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j223135574
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j4273879934
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j352243581
g.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning his affections?!

g.title: j3063744403
g.text: Oh this is truly magical! You took away all our memories in an attempt to have another try at winning my affections?!

g.title: j4163618282
g.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning her affections?!

g.title: j2364954105
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j4213416224
g.text: Do you know if I upset him in some way?

g.title: j1116070670
g.text: Any clue on how I can get him to talk to me?

g.title: j2727404050
g.text: She has brought it up a bit. She's convinced he can do no wrong?

g.title: j3240891417
g.text: She's devoted to Entrati how, exactly?

g.title: j457515515
g.text: Never mind. Never mind! It is done with. It is over.

g.title: j4048902081
g.text: Although you would be the expert in such things, wouldn't you?

g.title: j3761985844
g.text: Check boolean RoatheSerumDeal

g.title: j3821877375
g.text: Boolean RoatheKnowsReset2 is now true.

g.title: j3123114971
g.text: Oh. And one more thing, before I forget?

g.title: j3145812192
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of seeing Lyon through his pain, no matter what, this time around.

g.title: j2129205806
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of ensuring Marie "sees the light" about Entrati, no matter what, this time around.

g.title: j3061150477
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of resolving my conscience and these memories, no matter what, this time around.

g.title: j1454910813
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j1036257444
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j1074370048
g.text: How very Orokin of you.

g.title: j1374221804
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting Albrecht's butler and the family, no matter what, this time around.

g.title: j1375588157
g.text: Oh yes, actually. You mortally offended him, the moment you stepped in here. I just haven't had the heart to tell you.

g.title: j4068791672
g.text: Precisely. I'm unsure if one of those primitive kaithes kicked her in the head as a child, or if she is truly that sorely lacking for father figures, I do not know.

g.title: j1551915054
g.text: As a bit of a father figure, perhaps. Or a holy one. I am unsure if one of those primitive kaithes of their time kicked her in the head as a child, or if she was severely lacking for mentors, I do not know.

g.title: j2400670319
g.text: The point I am making, is that they are very keen to explain to me, at length, how I am quite horrible and that I should go about repenting and apologizing for everything I have ever done.

g.title: j2339978683
g.text: Boolean RoatheNoDeal is now false.

g.title: j1374706322
g.text: That leads me in the direction of a debate I think you are very much expecting to have... and win, doesn't it?

g.title: j3761985844->j1374706322
g.text: true

g.title: j4005817594
g.text: That leads me in the direction of a debate I think you are expecting to have, doesn't it?

g.title: j3761985844->j4005817594
g.text: false

g.title: j3866645924
g.text: Boolean RoatheRank2Convo1Complete is now true.

g.title: j3514862716
g.text: Not so very long ago, I trusted you with a horrible truth. Now I cannot remember why.

g.title: j1460595152
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonConfessionDeal is now true.

g.title: j717081436
g.text: Boolean RoatheMarieEntratiDeal is now true.

g.title: j2495199088
g.text: Boolean RoatheSerumDeal is now true.

g.title: j1736933276
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j2169786199
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j3033171542
g.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.

g.title: j1239248957
g.text: Boolean RoatheFamilyDeal is now true.

g.title: j3405045267
g.text: Are you lying to me?

g.title: j3613434498
g.text: How do I fix it?

g.title: j1573478826
g.text: Really? What did I do?

g.title: j6252898
g.text: How I desperately wish for her to wake up to the truth of Albrecht's lies. They are sitting all around her.

g.title: j1918062745
g.text: That does sound like hell.

g.title: j2958868449
g.text: Repent because you're an Orokin?

g.title: j2350987449
g.text: Repent for what happened on Tau?

g.title: j651943163
g.text: Repent about what?

g.title: j944539408
g.text: Boolean RoatheDeal is now true.

g.title: j978704988
g.text: Yes, and since we've been down this path before, I know exactly how it's going to end.

g.title: j1728964069
g.text: Do you really think this is a good time to do this?

g.title: j2014673756
g.text: No, what're you referencing?

g.title: j270982242
g.text: I'm expecting it. But are you ready to have it?

g.title: j3521636327
g.text: Yeah. But you don't feel comfortable enough with me yet to have it.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j933075002
g.text: You are both the one soul I may have ever hoped to trust... and the reason I now cannot recall why I had dared.

g.title: j3115308040
g.text: But mark my words, Drifter: You. Will. Owe. Me.

g.title: j2599738756
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with your dear Father Lyon Allard when the time is right.

g.title: j176523819
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting us, when the time is right... and I do look forward to it.

g.title: j2156048384
g.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with "little Marie" when the time is right.

g.title: j4076336123
g.text: No, why would I be? I have heard Lyon appreciates the kind of strange chocolate they had in his year. I've heard it calms his visions.

g.title: j1123488954
g.text: With chocolates. You bribe him by bringing him chocolates, Usurper. I have heard it calms his visions.

g.title: j3298883180
g.text: I have heard it is customary for people in his time to present priests a box of chocolates as a gift. Besides, I have heard chocolate calms his visions.

g.title: j4106529829
g.text: Consider this, if you will - if she can stare the truth dead in the face and still deny it with Albrecht? She is fully capable of doing the same with far more dangerous things.

g.title: j82764788
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j371378092
g.text: And why would they know the first thing about that? No, my Usurper.

g.title: j201059090
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j28116010
g.text: Now that we have that sorted and out of the way, how goes your progress so far with our little floating sycophant? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.

g.title: j1855181567
g.text: Do you, now?

g.title: j346284652
g.text: You do not get to decide when this conversation ends.

g.title: j2493509900
g.text: My memories may be lacking, Drifter - but my intelligence is not. Do not play me for a fool.

g.title: j1794022577
g.text: Understand what that makes you to me.

g.title: j28870025
g.text: Not today. Not tomorrow. But you will owe the Devil a debt.

g.title: j2500308537
g.text: Boolean RoatheLyonDatingDeal is now true.

g.title: j1546822738
g.text: Boolean RoatheDatingDeal is now true.

g.title: j3213473517
g.text: Boolean RoatheMarieDatingDeal is now true.

g.title: j3200144113
g.text: Check boolean MarieRoathePastry1

g.title: j3987352938
g.text: Bah! I can almost hear them now, screaming and shouting at me about how I am "corrupting you against them."

g.title: j3040799377
g.text: And a hell, it has been!

g.title: j3142907957
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellStory counter

g.title: j3422529504
g.text: Ha! I shall make you a list! It is exhaustive and yet nonspecific, always shifting from unknowable evils to seemingly unfathomable corruption!

g.title: j2822040373
g.text: Boolean RoatheKnowsReset2 is now true.

g.title: j3532772098
g.text: You're too angry. Right now, you're convinced you took the coward's way out, but you don't remember any of the rest of what led up to that moment.

g.title: j4236491168
g.text: You trusted me with your stories once before - but you don't right now. So the conversations we need to have? You can't.

g.title: j2011715312
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1336378485
g.text: Please stop lying to me.

g.title: j3200144113->j1336378485
g.text: true

g.title: j3200144113->j1336378485
g.text: false

g.title: j486491116
g.text: You sure you wouldn't prefer I just bring you some pastries? I've heard you like those.

g.title: j3200144113->j486491116
g.text: true

g.title: j1289602967
g.text: That one might be hard. Does Lyon have any other requests that he'd like me to get... him?

g.title: j3200144113->j1289602967
g.text: false

g.title: j1396301825
g.text: You do not know what it is like, to have those zealots hovering over your shoulder at all hours, screaming and lecturing at you about how you must repent.

g.title: j3615972620
g.text: I know we are at the limit, I can feel the strain of my mind fighting against me. You are doing the best you can to help me regain my memories. And for that, I am grateful.

g.title: j1013009726
g.text: We have just begun to unlock the barest drips and drabs of what was locked away from me. I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, Drifter.

g.title: j147721831
g.text: We have just begun to scratch the surface of what was locked away from me. I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, Drifter.

g.title: j3862842448
g.text: I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, for they are hidden even from me. The truth is hidden in my memories, Drifter.

g.title: j3142907957->j3862842448
g.text: false

g.title: j192548636
g.text: Under the surface, I know you're, well, a raging inferno. And I know we need to get to a certain point before we can talk it through.

g.title: j3187108169
g.text: And why would you trust me? All you know about me is that I... tampered with your memory.

g.title: j969777671
g.text: Well if you aren't going to be tedious, Drifter, why would I waste my time with you? I already have the zealots, and I'm seemingly required to spend time with them.

g.title: j2110747143
g.text: Ah, so she told you. Of course she did. Well, it is hardly my fault! Those damnable treats were the only good thing about that backwater hellhole of a city.

g.title: j2337450666
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2414960068
g.text: I need to know what was taken away from me, Drifter. I need to know what Albrecht robbed from me when he forced this serum upon me.

g.title: j1027596901
g.text: I need to know what Albrecht robbed from me when he forced this serum upon me. I need to know what is locked away inside my head, Drifter. Whenever it isn't an inconvenience for you, of course...

g.title: j3017659256
g.text: And why would I be angry, Drifter?

g.title: j2123062448
g.text: "Tampered with my memory." Like I am some Ayatan Sculpture being toyed with as a prank. You did more than just tamper with my memory. You struck it clean.

g.title: j1414734523
g.text: So it's true. You'd sneak off into Gaule to steal chocolates? Looking like...?

g.title: j696843067
g.text: How did you get them, exactly?

g.title: j687040345
g.text: Ha! Good sport. Blasted chocolates were the only good thing about that backwater hellhole of a city.

g.title: j1596346582
g.text: I promise.

g.title: j284763936
g.text: We'll get there. But this takes time.

g.title: j4199874711
g.text: I'll get there.

g.title: j3973336266
g.text: I'm trying. But you're not making it easy.

g.title: j607794458
g.text: You claimed you weren't angry at me for wiping your memories, but I know you're lying. Because... this isn't the first time I've done this.

g.title: j2428305900
g.text: Because you loathe yourself over taking that serum willingly. You hate yourself, and that's making you furious - because you is all you have left.

g.title: j4141890421
g.text: You claimed you weren't angry at me for wiping your memories, but I can't imagine how you wouldn't be furious.

g.title: j1573545008
g.text: You didn't lose anything worth keeping, just our conversations.

g.title: j1453116408
g.text: But not of everything - only of our conversations here. You still have everything else, even the ones we recovered in The Descendia.

g.title: j190769497
g.text: Yes, with the blue skin, tail, infested flesh, and all. It is astonishing what a cloak, hat and a mask can do for you.

g.title: j689227620
g.text: It was easy enough. Besides - as a "protoframe" and a battle-trained Orokin elite, I think I am capable enough to take some pastries from a market without alerting the authorities.

g.title: j2587844668
g.text: Before you ask, it's a story best told by Marie, lest I have the zealots screaming and ranting at me again.

g.title: j1980651524
g.text: Promises to the devil... a dangerous thing.

g.title: j4271232763
g.text: And I am a patient devil.

g.title: j3258788273
g.text: See that you do.

g.title: j2915520287
g.text: Of course not! Where would the fun in that be?

g.title: j3294003058
g.text: How wonderfully charming! And I am hardly even surprised! And what do I even care if that is the truth or not?! And besides which -

g.title: j671039560
g.text: Wrong! Breathtakingly, beautifully, blissfully wrong! Do not speak to me as though you know the intricacies of a rage I think you can so clearly not even begin to comprehend.

g.title: j3335241852
g.text: Do not dare to speak to me of what is valuable in my mind and what is not, Drifter. It is not yours over which to claim ownership.

g.title: j828982574
g.text: Humans are quick to dismiss those they wish not to see. Besides - as a "protoframe" and a battle-trained Orokin elite, I think I am capable enough to take some pastries from a market without alerting the authorities.

g.title: j227144189
g.text: Yes, with the blue skin, tail, infested flesh, and all. It is astonishing what a cloak, hat and a mask can do for you.

g.title: j3397211316
g.text: They shout and yell at me about sin and how I am in need of repenting enough, without adding "lying about my side of the story yet again" to the pile.

g.title: j4202875018
g.text: Boolean RoatheMariePastry1 is now true.

g.title: j690916714
g.text: But you brought back enough for Marie and Lyon?

g.title: j1942728004
g.text: So you just stole the pastries.

g.title: j2142201040
g.text: Ah. You expected me to, what, take enough just for myself and leave them without? Why, simply because I do not enjoy their company and wish to rid myself of them?

g.title: j1172663178
g.text: Everything on that planet was going to shortly belong to the Orokin Empire. It was mine by right, anyway.

g.title: j2197962567
g.text: You think that my dislike of them somehow necessitates that I also be cruel to them. Because I am a devil, and, therefore, prone to such acts, is the reasoning that follows.

g.title: j3367317834
g.text: Besides, I had no money. What did you expect me to do?

g.title: j4007601479
g.text: How utterly disappointing. Shallow acts like that are reserved for the extremely dull and the schoolyard bully.

g.title: j386527546
g.text: And I know you stampede your way through ships and take whatever it is you need or want - do not bat your innocent eyes at me, Usurper.

g.title: j349712165
g.text: I hate them. Yet I have to coexist with them. I do not wish them to be deprived of a silly pastry. It is a pastry. Why worsen matters so needlessly?

g.title: j991049834
g.text: Never mind.

g.title: j3189121654
g.text: Fair point, I guess.

g.title: j3216881872
g.text: Or, you could try being kind to them for the sake of it.

g.title: j3883575062
g.text: So, just to be clear - you were being nice, because you hate them.

g.title: j2796378981
g.text: I never thought about it that way, I guess.

g.title: j563661257
g.text: Fantastic. Another one who is incapable of conceding a point. As if the zealots weren't enough, screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.

g.title: j318174657
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2358228239
g.text: Yes, try having them buzzing about your ears all hours of every day and night cursing your name and crying at you to repent.

g.title: j1940759081
g.text: Precisely. What is so hard to understand? And I can tell you are being sarcastic, Usurper. But worry not, it amuses me.

g.title: j1941174391
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1807795856
g.text: Thank you. Finally, someone who can admit when they can concede! If only those two zealots could do the same, I wouldn't have them screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.

g.title: j733904982
g.text: It is at least better than the rancid, endless preaching the zealots do - constantly cursing and crying at me to repent.

g.title: j391661360
g.text: You are quite welcome. What a relief, to have someone who can change their viewpoint. If only those two zealots could do the same, I wouldn't have them screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.
